gloss: on the lake; over the lake

definitions.gloss: on the lake; over the lake; the lake surface
definitions.explanation: The surface of a lake or the area above it. Used to describe things happening on, over, or across a lake.

examples.japanese: {湖上|こじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかっている→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
{湖上|こじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{横切|よこぎ}った→横切る：02326_yokogiru⟧。
examples.english: We crossed the lake by boat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{湖上|こじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧{小舟|こぶね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{重|かさ}なって→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The silhouette of a small boat floating on the evening lake, overlapping with the sunset light reflected on the water's surface, was beautiful.

notes:
A compound of {湖|こ} (lake) and ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (above, on). Follows the same pattern as other location compounds: ⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧ (at sea), {山上|さんじょう} (on the mountain), ⟦{地上|ちじょう}→地上：12108_chijou⟧ (on the ground). Often appears in literary, scenic, and travel descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湖上|こじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: to float on the lake
- {湖上|こじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧: scenery on the lake
- {湖上|こじょう}クルーズ: lake cruise
- {湖上|こじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: wind blowing across the lake

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧: at sea; on the ocean — the equivalent term for the sea
- ⟦{湖面|こめん}→湖面：27150_komen⟧: lake surface — specifically the water surface itself
- ⟦{湖畔|こはん}→湖畔：17526_kohan⟧: lakeside; lakeshore — the land surrounding a lake, not on the water
